messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Computer Files are not accessible after deployment
parts:
The shinyFilesButton will show the files that exist where the Shiny application is running.
When you run it locally it will show the files on your local computer.
When you deploy it to shinyapps.io it will show the files on the server.

Per the description of the shinyFiles package:

Provides functionality for client-side navigation of the server side file system in shiny apps. In case the app is running locally this gives the user direct access to the file system without the need to ``download'' files to a temporary location. Both file and folder selection as well as file saving is available.
